citation: Chicago Park District, 'Clarence F. Buckingham Memorial Fountain' (history page).
author: Chicago Park District
rights_note: A City agency page, cited in words only.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-30 (T-3250) through a fetch that returned the history in short quoted fragments.
note: Fragments read: 'Philanthropist and art patron Kate Sturges Buckingham (1858-1937)' gave the funds; the fountain was 'dedicated to her brother, philanthropist and businessman Clarence Buckingham (1854-1913)'; it opened to the public on 26 May 1927 and was dedicated on 26 August 1927; Edward Bennett designed it with the French sculptor Marcel Francois Loyau and the engineer Jacques H. Lambert; modelled on the Latona Basin at Versailles, it 'is twice the size'; its major display sprays water 150 feet high.
what_it_supplies: Kate Sturges Buckingham as the donor and Clarence Buckingham as the brother it honours
the 1927 opening and dedication dates, its designers, its size against the Latona fountain and its 150-foot jet
what_it_does_not_supply: where the Buckinghams lived, which the 1904 Blue Book's Prairie Avenue list gives
